prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Make a high-resolution paired scene sheet: exactly TWO equal edge-to-edge TALL portrait game backgrounds side by side, each portrait about 390:844. Sharp division halfway across, no margins, borders, titles, labels or writing. Style references: image1 supplied Mars habitat interior for realistic cream fabric/metal, teal fittings and soft physical rendering; image2 is the established equipment materials, not a poster to reproduce. Each panel reserves LOWER 62% as broad quiet unobstructed floor/ground, viewed slightly downward; all architecture/story interest in upper 38%. No people or movable tools/items. Restrained retro expedition engineering, light dust, modest wear, believable folds and steel, no stylized cartoon outlines.
LEFT PANEL: the surveyed cave BEFORE construction. Broad low sound basalt cavern mouth framing a shallow chamber. Upper center floor at x50%,y27% is still covered by loose fine infill and small rounded rubble; dark roof overhead and irregular walls at sides; short survey stakes at margins only. View is into the cave from its entrance: a sliver of warm ochre sunlight touches entrance edge but interior is dim natural brown basalt. A quiet ochre fine-grained foreground is the working field. No pressure room, paving, lamps, furniture, machinery, excavator or plants. The rock roof supplies shielding, not breathable air. No unsupported tunnelling or dangerous hanging boulders.
RIGHT PANEL: inside the same cave's now installed EMPTY farm pressure enclosure, before any beds or furniture. Opaque ivory fabric envelope with convincing curved ribs and restrained teal seam clamps, a short integral airlock and service spine at rear right, white artificial grow-light rails along ceiling, broad smooth padded floor over regular modest ceramic paving edges visible at perimeter. Small sealed inspection window shows dark basalt CLOSE outside, NOT sky. NO transparent greenhouse roof, sunlight on crops, windows overlooking desert or glass dome. Dry alcove with a partially closed opaque partition at upper left; its interior is not visible. Simple imported heater/vent grille is mounted in service spine. Lower 65% empty grey-cream floor, quiet enough for game items. No beds, mattress, growing medium, reservoir, tools, crops or tank. The room is large enough for thirty square metres of future beds, not a small greenhouse cabinet. Factory finish only on imported pressure envelope and service equipment; any local edging is simple hand-cut cloth over joined ceramic blocks.
Both panels must be complete independent portrait scenes, consistent believable camera, generous open working field and important features within central 82% width for mobile crop.
